scenarios.name: Neural-Interface Commerce
scenarios.description: Direct brain-computer interface for immersive shopping experiences

parameters.futureVision: Customers think about products and instantly experience them in neural space, purchase with thought commands

scenarios.description: Quantum computing for real-time hyper-personalization at infinite scale

parameters.futureVision: Every customer gets a unique experience optimized across infinite variables simultaneously

scenarios.name: Autonomous Content Ecosystems
scenarios.description: Self-evolving content that adapts and creates itself based on audience needs

parameters.futureVision: Content becomes living organisms that learn, adapt, reproduce, and evolve without human intervention

scenarios.name: Holographic Customer Service
scenarios.description: AI-powered holographic agents providing 24/7 hyper-realistic customer support

parameters.futureVision: Indistinguishable-from-human holograms appear anywhere, understand context perfectly, solve any problem

scenarios.description: AI predicts customer needs before they know them, orchestrates perfect journeys

parameters.futureVision: Systems predict life events, preferences, and needs with 99% accuracy, proactively delivering value

scenarios.description: Blockchain-based federated learning creating collective intelligence for experiences

parameters.futureVision: Distributed networks where every interaction improves the system globally while maintaining privacy

parameters.futureVision: Environments sense frustration, joy, confusion and instantly adapt UI, content, pace, tone

scenarios.description: Photorealistic synthetic worlds indistinguishable from reality for product experiences

parameters.futureVision: Complete virtual showrooms that feel more real than reality, test products in any scenario

parameters.futureVision: Platforms where human + AI collective minds solve problems no individual could tackle

scenarios.name: Regenerative Business Models

parameters.futureVision: Every transaction creates positive externalities, systems self-heal and regenerate resources
